children: Japan's largest power generator, JERA, has entered into talks with Anthropic
, and other US tech giants to build data centers near power plants in the Tokyo area, Nikkei newspaper reported on Friday.
JERA Global CEO and Chair Yukio Kani said in a recent interview that the energy group is also in discussions with Amazon
JERA announced a partnership with Dell Technologies
and UK-based AI infrastructure developer RHAELM in October to accelerate the development of artificial intelligence infrastructure in Japan.
They signed a memorandum of understanding to develop a standardised model for building AI infrastructure on a national scale, starting with a $15 billion hyperscale data centre in Chiba, near Tokyo.
JERA, Anthropic, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft and Google did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment.
